notes.title: Stronghold Crusader: DE - First Major Update Details!
notes.content:
[h3][i]Well met, Sire![/i] Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition has charged into the breach and emerged from its launch victorious! The response of fans and critics to Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition has been nothing short of stellar. [/h3][p][/p][p]While we're still working hard to add the updates, fixes and tweaks that players have been requesting (see our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3024040/discussions/0/596281849306801145/"]extensive v1.03 Patch Notes[/url] for the latest changes), Firefly Studios is keeping this momentum going by revealing some of the details of new gameplay content that players can look forward to[/p][p][/p][p]The first major ‘Autumn’ update will arrive in two parts -  a free content update as well as an optional paid DLC. The free content will introduce The Crocodile, a brand new computer-controlled opponent with his own tactics, castle design, army and of course, snappy personality![/p][p][/p][h3] > [b][u][url="https://youtu.be/Yn98HHTPl4k"]Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition Tacticon Showcase[/url][/u][/b] <[/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452156/b86d8ee7078fe5c7b55d77d3634979d2160566c5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The wizened lord of the marshes, The Crocodile is a bitter cruel fellow, driven beyond sanity by envy of his rival lords. Players will encounter The Crocodile across a new five mission economic campaign, in addition to being playable in skirmish mode (and in case you’re wondering - yes, the game has [i]actual [/i]crocodiles, too.) [/p][p][/p][p]While there will be some degree of combat to contend with in the economic campaigns, the ultimate goal and thus victory will be decided by mastery of the game’s various economic industries and castle-life mechanics. The free component of the Autumn Update will be capped off by the inclusion of three new maps, one for Skirmish, Freebuild and Multiplayer.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/7e913c19b867710e01e146ce956448016cbc3536.png"][/img][/p][p]The paid DLC will feature two new CPU commanders in the form of The Canary and The Trader, and a new 9 mission ‘Sands of Time’ skirmish trail - complete with target completion times and leaderboards. Players can expect military scenarios will test their strategic prowess and skills of siegecraft, as they wage war against these new tricky CPU characters. Fear not, more about these new adversaries and their attributes will be revealed in due time![/p][hr][/hr][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/59e21472a7555da6a8e316f878fe973f43fe3f13.png"][/img][/p][p]After Stronghold Crusader: DE’s fantastic launch, Firefly is highly determined to keep pushing further, through the likes of additional content updates and gameplay improvements, to truly make this definitive edition the completely elevated tribute of a strategy classic![/p][p][/p][h2][b][i]Play Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition on Steam now![/i][/b][/h2][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3024040/Stronghold_Crusader_Definitive_Edition/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition - Out Now!
notes.content:
[h3]The time is NOW, Sire! The long march is finally over and your forces have finally arrived at our divine destination - Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition is out now with a 10% launch discount![/h3][p][/p][h3][b]-->[/b] [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZanPPwupPz4"]Behold this glorious love-letter to the golden age of strategy games with a freshly-forged launch trailer[/url] [b]<--[/b]
[/h3][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452156/3428ff187834c06f64fb9dd9dbea330ae05ad4b9.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]The fan reception to Stronghold: Definitive Edition in 2023 showed us the hunger in the community for more games that take the cult classic games of the past, leaving the gold while elevating the old. The tremendous outpouring of love has pushed us to make this definitive edition of the fan-favourite Crusader the best it possible can be, adding more features, fixes and content than anyone could have expected. We can't wait to see how fans take this reimagined classic and make it their own. [/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452156/9ab26dce854ef8398e3416cbf0c264f3769047c8.png"][/img][/p][p]Every bit of feedback across our demos has helped to inform the final game, allowing us to craft this expanded remaster hand-in-hand with the community. This player-first development focus has helped to shape this into a love letter to the golden age of isometric strategy games, one that will continue after launch with a robust roadmap of updates and DLC.

The fundamental game will feel like an elevated version of the classic experience for returning fans and new players alike. With improvements and expansions to practically every core feature and beyond: reworked visuals, higher fidelity audio, new units, new AI Lords, new modes, 10k units cap, co-op, new missions, larger-than-ever maps, 8-player Steam multiplayer, Steam Workshop support, QoL improvements and more![/p][p][/p][p]Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition is the culmination of almost a quarter century of development experience, fan support and technological advancements. Better-looking, smoother-running and bigger in all ways possible, Stronghold Crusader: DE is the ultimate way to take a trip down memory lane.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452156/d00e71b9e422ace830648eb4cf99b46888c12bb8.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Critical Reception[/h3][p][b]Inverse (9/10)[/b] -- [i]"This Definitive Edition is a genuinely massive update that improves the game in a handful of crucial ways. It’s taken one of the best castle builders of all time and transformed it into something truly definitive."[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Finger Guns (9/10)[/b] -- [i]"Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition sets a gold standard of what should be expected of remasters."[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]4Players (8.5/10)[/b] -- [i]"Stronghold Crusader Definitive Edition offers the core of the RTS masterpiece in a beautiful, fluid, and improved form."[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Stronghold Crusader DE is out NOW on Steam with a 10% launch discount![/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3024040/Stronghold_Crusader_Definitive_Edition/"][/dynamiclink][b]Seen a bug? Got feedback? [/b]Please submit issues both large and small through the [url="https://firefly-studios.helpshift.com/hc/en/15-stronghold-definitive-edition/contact-us/"]Firefly Studios support site[/url]. Between this and our [b]planned post-launch roadmap[/b] we are dedicated to fixing any significant issues players are having and the more reports we get the faster and more effectively we can do that :)[/p][p] [dynamiclink href="https:///url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZanPPwupPz4"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition Roadmap Reveal
notes.content:
[h3]Good Day Sire! Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition is just under two weeks away from its launch, so what better time than now to share all there is to know about its post-launch plans![/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="71UzpnLOH7U;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Following the positive reception of the two public demos and in keeping with Stronghold DE’s post-launch, we're announcing two major post-launch content updates for Stronghold Crusader DE. These will take the form of an Autumn and a Winter Update, both releasing this year alongside two paid DLCs.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45452156/8f40990ce7a71421b643639197584c99a4027f26.png"][/img][/p][p]The free initial Autumn Update will feature a series-first economic campaign as well as a brand new CPU commander. Five missions will challenge players to complete a series of economic objectives, leaning heavily into the city builder gameplay mechanics of the legendary castle builder series. The new computer-controlled character can meanwhile also be played as friend or foe, selectable in the game’s offline skirmish and online multiplayer modes. Last but not least, three new maps will also be added, one for skirmish, another in Free Build mode and a balanced multiplayer battlefield.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45452156/5313cab036a111f6c5b495987e9b8564aad4fdd7.png"][/img][/p][p]Following this content drop, the game’s free Winter Update will add perhaps the greatest player request so far: the ability to customise CPU opponents, castles and campaigns! Players will be able to create the rivals or allies of their dreams (or nightmares), design their defences and then place all of this into custom mission scenarios created by the community.[/p][p] [/p][p]If that wasn’t enough, the Winter Update continues this community-first trend with the addition of a second co-op trail of missions. The 10 missions found in the first co-op trail not enough for you? Well, dare to brave the challenges of this new trail and you [i]just [/i]might come out victorious. Once again a new map pack of three maps will be added to the overall pool, keeping things fresh for players after launch.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3024040/Stronghold_Crusader_Definitive_Edition/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition launches soon on July 15th. Wishlist now to be the first to know when it goes live![/h2]

notes.title: Stronghold Crusader DE Feature Spotlight: 10k Unit Cap, Mosques & More!
notes.content:
[h3]Good morrow, my liege! [/h3]After 150,000 demo downloads, three times as many as Stronghold: Definitive Edition... We have channelled thousands of your Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition feedback forms into new player-requested enhancements!

[url=https://youtu.be/js6TBaUA8QQ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452156/c24564dfa03288026148dc565aab9897c05aa756.jpg[/img][/url]

Ahead of the game's July 15th launch, today we dive into some of these community-requested features, confirming key information on maximum unit counts and more in our final ‘Feature Spotlight’ development diary.

As some of Crusader’s most knowledgeable and experienced players, your feedback on our upcoming Definitive Edition has been invaluable. So naturally suggestions and ideas discussed online were studied in close detail, ahead of the game’s reveal earlier this year. Your Crusader: DE feedback was then examined after January 20th through the demo’s feedback form.
Many features have been requested by players since January.

[url=https://youtu.be/js6TBaUA8QQ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452156/b1aef7bb484c7d3703313c64d0336dbd82d79a71.png[/img][/url]

These include raising the overall troop count to a whopping 10,000 soldiers in a single game, to match that of Stronghold Crusader Extreme, which we can confirm today. We have also made the addition of a few Islamic buildings and related workers for the game’s Arabic and Bedouin Lords, as well as many vital bug fixes. The latter addresses specific exploits and issues discovered by the game’s most dedicated players across more than 20 years of play.

[url=https://youtu.be/js6TBaUA8QQ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452156/c0df1d7dcfef1b0424b0019399ec1b9064ff6e27.png[/img][/url]

From map sizes up to four times the size of those available in the original, through to custom toggles for skirmish mode and online leader boards, we are striving to tick every possible box for fans of the original game. A Definitive Edition should include absolutely everything possible that players want out of Crusader and that’s what this final version of our game intends to deliver!

[h3]Wishlist Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition today![/h3]

notes.title: Feature Spotlight: New Units In Stronghold Crusader DE!
notes.content:
[h3]Good day, my liege![/h3] After a few eagle-eyed players infiltrated the help files, Assassin style, in our Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition reveal demo, we thought it was time to pull back the curtain on our 8 new units. Today’s Feature Spotlight video brings with it new footage and juicy gameplay details for our Bedouin soldiers, expanding the original roster with fresh tactical options at launch on July 15th.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=um9P-_v5RSM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/9be649ca707adcdbf2c0df2939e3965f697f8918.jpg[/img][/url]

Inspired by the roaming Bedouin tribes of the Middle Eastern deserts, these eight new troops open up a whole new world of siege tactics (and hurt!) on your rival lords. Be they friends you played the OG Crusader with way back in the day or new Stronghold allies found in our official Discord server[discord.com], enemy Lords and Ladies won’t know what hit them. From camel-riding lancers and bowmen, to sneaking fire-starters and demolition specialists, our expanded remaster adds plenty of new options for commanders in the art of medieval warfare.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/58d76785a7cfcd7f45c4121597a35f407bb2cbcd.png[/img]

In our latest Feature Spotlight we reveal exactly what these new units are capable of and how you might use them to your advantage in your next medieval conquest. So please check out the video, learn their strengths, weaknesses and let us know what you think in the comments below! Player feedback has been a huge part of the success of our Definitive Editions, so as always we’d love to hear your thoughts for this upcoming game and of course future titles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/36187f08ed05c18b04032033b2e839e421139ae2.png[/img]

[h3]Stay tuned for future videos to hear more about the updates and improvements coming to Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition and wishlist the game to be notified of the game's release at launch.[/h3]

notes.title: Play Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition Demo Today!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Sire![/h2] [h3]Gird your loins and sharpen your steel because 23 years after it first launched, we’re incredibly excited to announce [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3024040/Stronghold_Crusader_Definitive_Edition/]Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition![/url][/h3] 

Travel back in time to the legendary crusades for the holy land in this new expanded definitive edition, releasing this year on July 15th 2025 with brand new content, elevated graphics and extensive player-requested features all rebuilt by game’s original developers!

This title is many people’s favourite old-school 2D RTS, so taking this cult favourite and elevating it for the modern player has been an endeavour of passion for us – one that is only possible because of the community’s clear desire for this kind of classic strategy experience. The best way we could think of thanking you for your support has been to go above and beyond, with new AIs, missions, modes and maps, as well as the Steam multiplayer and workshop integrations that the original could never have had.

What better way to kick off the Steam RTS Fest than a demo of this reinvented gem, heralded with a shiny new reveal trailer, masterfully scored by the legendary bard of Stronghold himself, Robert L. Euvino! This trailer showcases the depth of work and love poured into the remaster. We really hope you enjoy it! 

Flex your might against 20 challenging AI lords, charge through the new co-op trail with a friend or dive into skirmish mode featuring larger maps, custom options and quality of life fixes – Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition allows you to revisit a reimagined strategy classic and play exactly the way you want to!

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3024040/Stronghold_Crusader_Definitive_Edition/]Wishlist Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition[/url] now on Steam ahead of the game’s full release on July 15th 2025 and play the demo right now![/h3]

notes.title: New "Valley of the Wolf" DLC Campaign + Free New Castle Trail + v1.31 Hotfix
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=G83sagx-Tds;full][/previewyoutube]
Today we released both version v1.3 of [b]Stronghold: Definitive Edition[/b] and our second DLC campaign, [i]"Valley of the Wolf"[/i]. Now available at 10% off during launch week, Stronghold: Definitive Edition's second DLC adds seven new missions concluding the story of your attempts to rescue the Jewel, this time from the legendary Wolf.

[list][*][b]A New Story[/b] - Rescue the Jewel in this new campaign featuring the greatest foe in the Stronghold series, the villainous Wolf!
[*][b]7 Epic Missions[/b] - Prove yourself as a Stronghold veteran and strategist, with some of our most challenging military scenarios yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/1dab3107a05b708744775ac6c74d1d7b16ec6569.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2728000/Stronghold_Definitive_Edition__Valley_of_the_Wolf_Campaign/


[b]Version Number: v1.31 (hotfix)
Date: 13 May 2024
Update Size: 20.5 MB[/b]

[b]UPDATES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a Victory screen that includes The Jewel at the end of ‘Knocking on the Door’
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where corrupted save or map files would stop the game from loading.
[*] Fixed an issue where more foods or weapons could not be bought despite there being space in the granary/armory.
[*] Fixed an issue where invasions of certain sizes and make-ups would not attack as expected, fixing The Eagle’s Nest (Valley of the Wolf) on Hard/Very Hard difficulties.
[*] Fixed incorrect images in the epilogues for ‘Knocking on the Door’ and ‘A Castle for the Ages’.
[*] Fixed a missing victory screen that includes The Jewel at the end of ‘Knocking on the Door’.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the text in Valley of the Wolf to appear in incorrect locations (Russian only). 
[/list]


[b]Version Number: v1.3
Date: 30 April 2024
Update Size: 76.5 MB[/b]


[b]UPDATES[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a second castle trail, ‘The Noble Trail’
- Battle across Europe, attacking and defending 10 of the most historic castles of Poland, Spain, Hungary, Italy, Germany and France.
[*] Added new siege castles
- Castillo de Coca, Fougères, Biskupin, Malbork, Diósgyőr, Fénis, Niedzica (Dunajec), Ogrodzieniec
[*] Added new maps
- Sleeping Volcano, Freebuild, 400x400 - An extensive map with a peaceful coastline, a plentiful forest and a sleeping volcano encircling a picturesque inner lake.
- 4 Rivers, Multiplayer, 400x400 - Each realm is separated by rivers with limited crossing opportunities. The stone and iron rich mountains double up as useful defensive positions.
- Three's a Crowd, Multiplayer, 400x400 - A three player map where fickle alliances and treachery thrive.
Downstream, Multiplayer, 400x400 - As the river flows through the middle of the landscape, which lord will secure their victory?
- Forlorn Hope, MP (King of the Hill), 400x400 - A four player map where feuding lords will have to risk much for great reward.[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues where very large invasions on custom maps would crash.
[*] Fixed engineer availability on all Swine’s Bay missions.
[*] Fixed an exploit where players could create duplicate engineers by grouping.
[*] Fixed an issue where armies on custom maps would disappear.
[*] Fixed missing audio from Tanner Workshop video.
[*] Fixed autotrade settings in Multiplayer saves.
[*] Fixed gold showing minus figures in objectives if they acquire too much gold.
[*] Fixed ‘Time Until Victory’ progress bar not filling correctly in certain scenarios.
[*] Fixed the Host not seeing chat messages in multiplayer lobbies after maps are retrieved.
[*] Fixed it so that Siege Mode can no longer be started with no AI Troops ending in Victory.
[*] Removed incorrect Ox Tether on ‘Taunting the Hog’.
[*] Fixed various issues with tree life cycles, especially on maps with large numbers of trees.
[*] Fixed broken wall in ‘A Timely Arrival’.
[*] Fixed objective setup for capturing the keep in ‘A Timely Arrival’.
[*] Fixed an issue where invasions would attack in waves rather than all at once.
[*] Fixed battering rams without full engineers being unattackable.
[*] Fixed inconsistent trade goods positioning.
[*] Fixed an issue where quarry storage pallets could end up in unpathable locations.
[*] Full proofread and re-translation of Ukrainian text by [url=https://sbt.localization.com.ua/]SBT Localization[/url].  Thanks to Dmytro for flagging the issue and suggesting SBT.
[*] Lots of fixes to the Korean text courtesy of Gripen (Jeonggi Song).  Thanks for your amazing help!
[*] Proofread and standardisation of key terms in Hungarian.  Thanks to Tamás Kondi for highlighting the issue.
[*] Various other text fixes in all languages.
[/list]

For support, please contact us through our support site: [url=]https://firefly-studios.helpshift.com/hc/en/15-stronghold-definitive-edition/[/url]

notes.title: Valley of the Wolf DLC & Spring Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=G83sagx-Tds;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Snarls[/b] Soon you will see what it means to wage real warfare! That is... In our final instalment of the [i]Stronghold: Definitive Edition[/i] 'Jewel' campaign! [i]Valley of the Wolf[/i] extends the base game with seven new missions and extra achievements. Under the tutelage of the wise Sergeant, finish the fight by rescuing Sir Longarm's captured kin once and for all, when this new DLC releases for $2.99, €2.99 and £2.49 on April 30th.

This final chapter of 'The Jewel' campaign pits players against the greatest rogue of them all... The vicious Wolf! To safely retrieve the Jewel of the North and put an end to The Wolf's insidious scourge, players must plunge directly into the belly of the beast and bring the fight to his borders. Against great odds in unfamiliar territory, survival alone demands that nothing is held back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/2b9963782dc67c026c2acefb080542035cb6a9eb.jpg[/img]

Also arriving on April 30th is our FREE 'Spring Update', featuring a second castle trail of 10 siege scenarios. This new 'Noble Trail' will arrive alongside additional maps for Multiplayer, Free Build and Siege modes, with the exciting (and long overdue!) introduction of our first ever Polish castles to be featured in a Stronghold game.

Malbork, the fortress erected by the Teutonic Order to signify their Prussian conquest, Biskupin, an ancient stronghold built at the dawn of Rome, and Niedzica, a daunting gothic castle that Dracula would be proud of, will all be found in the new castle trail, while another castle, Ogrodzieniec, will be playable as a standalone map through Siege mode. All will be made available for free as part of the Spring Update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/4c4b82cdb725233e21086e10e8780ad4a5da0f9e.jpg[/img]

We would like to thank our Polish fans who suggested these epic citadels online and in person last year, at events like Gamescom and EGX. Your support for [i]Stronghold: Definitive Edition[/i] has been incredible and we hope to bring demos of future Stronghold games to events in Poland. So please keep an eye on our socials for the latest news!

Be sure to return on April 30th and check out our full patch notes at release, for both the paid Valley of the Wolf DLC and free Spring Update. These will include a run down of other minor features, fixes and improvements coming to the game as part of the Spring Update in version 1.3.

Thanks for playing!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2728000/Stronghold_Definitive_Edition__Valley_of_the_Wolf_Campaign/

notes.title: New "Swine's Bay" DLC Campaign + Free New Economic Campaign
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Ky5f7blJ1l0;full][previewyoutube=UzmPG_Mysh0;full][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]
Today we released both version v1.2 of [b]Stronghold: Definitive Edition[/b] and our first DLC campaign, [i]"Swine's Bay"[/i]. Now available at 10% off during launch week, Stronghold: Definitive Edition's first DLC adds seven new missions continuing the story of your attempts to rescue the Jewel, this time from the notorious Slaver Captain Hogsfoot.

[list][*][b]A New Story[/b] - Rescue the Jewel from the scurvy-ridden clutches of the wretched Slaver Captain Hogsfoot in a new campaign.
[*][b]7 Epic Missions[/b] - Prove yourself as a Stronghold veteran and strategist, with some of our most challenging military scenarios yet.
[*][b]Fresh Gameplay[/b] - Tackle each mission with 20 years of Stronghold experience and unique spins on traditional series gameplay.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/a49f25619514b20ed5ddb901f4117a82591e46e9.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2727990/Stronghold_Definitive_Edition__Swines_Bay_Campaign/


[b]Version Number: v1.2
Date: 13 Feb 2024
Update Size: 150 MB[/b]


[b]UPDATES[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the ‘Home Fires’ Economic Campaign
- A brand new economic campaign featuring 7 challenging missions created by the designer of the original Stronghold campaigns, Simon Bradbury.
[*] Added 2 new Multiplayer maps
- Snake Island - 2 players, 400x400 - “Island warfare as two castles battle it out across narrow crossings to a neutral peninsula.”
- Vile Gulch - 4 players, 400x400 - “War for your quarter, as 4 Lords battle against each other while trying to avoid getting stuck in the mud.”

- Forest - 400x400 - “An overgrown area that can be expanded into a vast open plain, rich with resources and the chance for a peaceful castle life.”
[*] Added Increasing Attack Sizes option to Freebuild advanced options
- To use this, click on the “Invasion Difficulty” to cycle through until it changes to “Increasing Difficulty”
- There are three speeds (Slow, Medium and Fast) which determine after how many attacks the difficulty will increase
- The invasions still use the “Repeating Invasions” timer option and respect the ‘Peace Time’ option
[*] Added Steam Trading Cards
[*] Added Private Multiplayer lobbies, with invite codes
- These can be used to invite players that are not necessarily on your Steam friend’s list
[*] Added Max Players setting to Multiplayer lobbies
[*] Added ability to hover over campaign mission names and show if the mission has been completed, and on which difficulty.
[*] Added scroll button to scroll through units in the UI when more than 8 unit types are selected
[*] Added Keep enclosed icon to the minimap
[*] Added ability to reload multiple Catapults/Trebuchets with rocks
[*] Mission 18 - End of the Pig - Updated player’s troops starting positions so they’re not instantly dying at the start of the mission
[*] Added pulse effect to Multiplayer ‘Ready’ shield
[*] Added ‘Balanced’ to Steam Workshop map tags
[*] Added right-click to move back in Market panels
[*] Moat delete is now draggable
[*] Opening Multiplayer chat will now show the last 5 messages
[*] Added Waypoint and Patrol information to ‘Controlling Military Units’ in the Help file
[*] Added videos for The Sergeant to all missions in The Jewel Campaign

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/5d5545fee9f195ee8f11f49dc61ed6dab9bc2a32.gif[/img]
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed Pike production from ‘Two Hovels & a Bucket of Fish’
[*] AI Character videos now stop playing instead of freezing on the final frame.
[*] Various text fixes in all languages
[*] Fixed Knight rally points
[*] Fixed wall pieces remaining after being deleted if placed in certain positions
[*] Added help icon to Good and Bad Lord buildings
[*] Fixed floating wheat farmers
[*] Fixed an issue where disbanding troops while they were patrolling would cause free peasants to start patrolling
[*] Fixed an issue that caused looping sfx on briefing screen
[*] Fixed an issue where, rarely, Hunter’s would not return to their posts after catching deer
[*] Fixed an issue where sometimes AI would attack their own gatehouse in custom missions
[*] Fixed gatehouse repair button not always showing active state correctly
[*] Fixed minimap team colours
[*] Improved unit sprite clipping when standing on a gatehouse

notes.title: New Dev Diaries & Gameplay
notes.content:
[h2]Developer Diary - Episode 2[/h2]
[previewyoutube=ZVyWb3tqtds;full][/previewyoutube]

In our second [i]Stronghold: Definitive Edition[/i] dev diary we discuss the genesis of the game, while delving into changes made as part of this new edition. Join Stronghold series veterans Simon and Paul, as they provide insight into the creation of our latest game from their unique perspectives.

We discuss the aims of Stronghold: DE and goals for everything from new single player content, all the way down to the smallest quality of life enhancements. Starting with the initial project pitch, then leading to questions of the scale of changes and finer elements like the actual difficulty of the new content, the road to release has been carefully considered.

It also gives us great pleasure in this video to confirm some of these changes and a few entirely new ones! In response to player feedback we have increased troop and building limits across all game modes, allowing for up to 3000 units and 2000 buildings at a time. By doubling these limits from the original game, we hope to provide you with more epic Stronghold sieges than ever before.

[h2]Developer Diary - Episode 3[/h2]
[previewyoutube=Y6dqDSJov1w;full][/previewyoutube]

We then round off our trio of behind-the-scenes videos by adding production expert Dave to the mix! It's time to talk Steam multiplayer, Workshop and the other improvements coming to your favourite game modes. What to expect from Workshop support, more details on multiplayer in DE and planned improvements to Free Build mode are all touched on, with extra insight into the development process of this unique game.

Making Stronghold more accessible has always been a key goal of the Definitive Edition and bringing our amazing multiplayer community - as well as the awesome maps they've created over the course of two decades - front and centre within Steam is how we're hoping to accomplish that. Thousands of fan creations can soon exist within Steam Workshop and be easily accessible for future generations of Stronghold players, with an improved set of multiplayer options to support years of continued play.

Add to this a few choice improvements to Free Build - everyone's favourite cozy game mode - and you have plenty to look forward to come release. In the meantime please check out our recent Free Build Q&A and Campaign Gameplay videos, where we confirm new features like Rally Points and discuss the series' 20 year legacy:

[h2]Free Build Q&A[/h2]
[previewyoutube=o2vMq9z_Dik;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Campaign Gameplay[/h2]
[previewyoutube=N5MIqMtuFkA;full][/previewyoutube]

Stay tuned for more updates between now and release as we process all your valuable feedback and incorporate as many changes as we can before launch. Thank you once again for your continued support and we hope you join us on November 7th by wishlisting the game on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2140020/Stronghold_Definitive_Edition/

notes.title: 🏰 Final Demo Now Live 🏰
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/7d03753b4080826dbf9bd5d6741b9a9269472e24.jpg[/img]

Castle builders and fans of feudal taxation rejoice! As part of [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zQLCg46Q8nY]Steam Next Fest: October Edition[/url] and in celebration of almost 200,000 wishlists, we have just released a brand new [i]Stronghold: Definitive Edition[/i] demo - Our final playable build before launch!

[h2]👇 Play Now 👇[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2140020/Stronghold_Definitive_Edition/

Available exclusively on Steam as part of Next Fest, this demo features never-before-seen-missions - including your first look at our brand new single player campaign. This includes Missions 3 and 8 from the original 2001 [i]Stronghold[/i] military campaign, as well as a challenging mission from the exclusive new Definitive Edition campaign. Need a refresher? Then dive into the demo's full tutorial to warm up first.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/cd4f39dac44de6f57729e1f817d89f88cc542d2a.jpg[/img]

In addition to both of the original military and economic campaigns, the ‘Jewel of the North’ DE campaign will feature returning fan favourite antagonists The Rat and The Snake. Created by Firefly co-founders Simon Bradbury and Eric Ouellette, these new missions will remain true to the spirit of the first game, while introducing new twists on familiar Stronghold gameplay.

To accompany the release of our final demo, we have also released an in-depth developer diary featuring interviews with veteran series artists. Watch as Darrin and Niall examine the artistic challenges inherent in a project like [i]Stronghold: Definitive Edition[/i]:

[previewyoutube=AUIN8YV3-9A;full][/previewyoutube]
“Being able to go back to [Stronghold] and updating it in some ways but still keeping the original feel in other ways. That I think is what we really all were shooting for,” explains Senior Graphic Designer Darrin Horbal. Reflecting on the game’s summer reveal, Lead Artist Niall Benzie goes on to explain, “When we first released the trailer and the public demo, I was quite apprehensive on how people might receive the changes, but I do believe we have gone a long way in trying to respect the original art”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366650/dd56683ef75c4d84d96748fac732218faa12d59b.jpg[/img]

Our new Definitive Edition demo will remain available for one week, until the end of Steam Next Fest on October 16 at 10:00 AM PDT / 17:00 GMT. We encourage you to download the demo and leave us feedback! As with our previous demo there is a feedback form embedded in the game's main menu. So please build, besiege and let us know what you think.

We can't wait to share more DE news as we approach launch on November 7th - So stay tuned for more Stronghold goodness in the coming weeks!
